codeReview.summary: Core Sentry bootstrap, breadcrumbs helpers, and source-map build wiring are present, but the feature does not fully cover frontend error reporting or API breadcrumb coverage.

issues.description: Route/module error boundaries never call `Sentry.captureException`. `frontend/src/root.tsx` and many route modules export `ErrorBoundary()` functions that render `RouteErrorView`, so loader failures and route-boundary render errors bypass `components/shared/ErrorBoundary.tsx` and are silently dropped instead of being reported to Sentry.

`apiDownload()` still performs a `fetch()` without adding a Sentry breadcrumb, so download requests used by the workflows and scraped-data screens are missing from the promised API-call breadcrumb trail.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared service catalog still recommends `npm --prefix frontend install` and `npm --prefix server install`, but mission guidance says those commands can inject the spurious `anti: file:..` dependency and should be avoided in favor of `cd <dir> && npm install`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/services.yaml:3-4 uses the `npm --prefix ... install` commands, while mission AGENTS.md:79-82 documents them as a gotcha and prescribes `cd frontend && npm install` / `cd server && npm install`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Frontend source-map upload now depends on `SENTRY_ORG` and `SENTRY_PROJECT`, but the shared environment docs only mention DSN variables and `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: frontend/vite.config.ts:97-99 reads `SENTRY_ORG`, `SENTRY_PROJECT`, and `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`, while .factory/library/environment.md:15-17 only documents the DSN variables and omits the org/project settings.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker skill and the worker handoff feedback are out of sync: the skill requires reading `.factory/library/architecture.md`, listing affected files, and running all five validators, but this feature transcript/handoff only shows frontend build and lint while still claiming `followedProcedure: true`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md:24-29 and 68-77 require architecture review plus all validators; the handoff verification block for this feature only lists `npm --prefix frontend run build` and `npm --prefix frontend run lint`.

summary: Review failed. The feature wires Sentry init, shared error boundary capture, breadcrumbs helpers, and build-time source-map hooks, but route-boundary errors still are not reported to Sentry and download API requests are not breadcrumbed.
